email.subject: Studio 9 Group's site may be losing bookings
email.body:
Hi Sam,

I took a quick look at Studio 9 Group's website. Two things stood out: there's no booking link anywhere, so people who want to grab a slot have to call during business hours instead of just clicking a button -- and the site isn't mobile-friendly, which matters since most people search for a salon on their phone. Between those two, you're likely losing people before they ever reach out.

I fix local business sites for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd change?

Alex
Northlight Web
